name: belay-examples
description: Belay examples: ticket triage, content moderation and intent detection, with calibration configs.

scripts.calibrate:triage: cd ticket-triage && belay calibrate --task ticket-triage --data examples.jsonl
scripts.calibrate:moderation: cd content-moderation && belay calibrate --task content-moderation --data examples.jsonl
scripts.calibrate:intent: cd intent-detection && belay calibrate --task intent-detection --data examples.jsonl
scripts.calibrate:extraction: cd event-extraction && belay calibrate --task event-extraction --data examples.jsonl
